lines.text: For exaltation comes neither from east nor west,
but it is God who judges;
He brings down one and exalts another.
For a cup is in the hand of the LORD,
full of foaming wine mixed with spices.
and all the wicked of the earth
drink it down to the dregs.
But I will proclaim Him forever;
I will sing praise to the God of Jacob.
“All the horns of the wicked I will cut off,
but the horns of the righteous will be exalted.”

pictures.scene: Cornelius van Poelenburgh, Italianiserend landschap met een oudtestamentisch onderwerp — the men standing in the open country arguing it out with a finger raised, or speak with an outstretched neck, for exaltation comes neither from east nor west
pictures.name: pd_poelenburgh_italianiserend_landschap

pictures.scene: Eugen Bracht, Aus der Sinai-Wüste — the empty sand and sandstone of the Sinai with the camels going over it, nor out of the desert, but it is God who judges
pictures.name: pd_bracht_sinai_wueste

pictures.scene: Diego Velázquez, The Waterseller of Seville — the glass passed from the old man's hand down into the boy's, He brings down one and exalts another, for a cup is in the hand of the LORD
pictures.name: pd_velazquez_waterseller_seville

pictures.scene: Anthonie Palamedesz., Vrolijk gezelschap in een kamer — the boy tipping the jug to fill the glass for the company, full of foaming wine mixed with spices, He pours from His cup
pictures.name: pd_palamedesz_vrolijk_gezelschap

pictures.scene: Frans Hals, De vrolijke drinker — the man turned round with the glass still up in his hand, and all the wicked of the earth drink it down to the dregs
pictures.name: pd_hals_vrolijke_drinker

pictures.scene: Hans Memling, Christus met zingende en musicerende engelen — the angels singing out of the open book beside the crowned Christ, but I will proclaim Him forever, I will sing praise to the God of Jacob
pictures.name: pd_memling_singing_angels

pictures.scene: Christian Kröner, Frühmorgens am Renneckenberg — the stag standing up on the height in the morning light with his antlers lifted, all the horns of the wicked I will cut off, but the horns of the righteous will be exalted
pictures.name: pd_kroener_hirsche_renneckenberg
